I booked Zed Hotel through Booking.com, but when I arrived, they told me no rooms were available and shifted me to another property. The alternate hotel was of very poor quality, not like what I had booked, and they even overcharged for food. When I called Zed Hotel to report the issue, they simply disconnected my call. Very disappointing experience — not recommended at all.
